verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents how LiveKit's media layer scales across nodes or regions, either through managed autoscaling or self-hosted clustering. The nearby items cover adjacent topics only: deployment packaging (single binary, Docker or Kubernetes), Cloud-hosted agents running without server management, region-restricted telephony trunks, and single-port UDP firewall configuration. None of these describes multi-node or multi-region media scaling.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, the vendor documents how the media layer scales across nodes or regions, whether managed autoscaling or self-hosted clustering
